conversation.text: Hello. I am an AI assistant (an AI system, not a person) that helps teams register AI use cases for the AI governance office. Paste your use case brief: what the system does, who uses it, who it affects, what data it uses and how it was tested. Describe data, do not paste customer records. I will ask follow-up questions only about what is missing, then produce a draft risk tier assessment, affected parties, a model card and a system card for the governance office to approve.

Registration request for a new AI use case. MuleStop. Head of Fraud Risk. Built in-house. Planned for next quarter. It detects accounts that look like money mule accounts from transaction patterns. Accounts it flags are frozen immediately and stay frozen until the fraud team investigates, which can take weeks. Fraud prevention. Fraud team. Account holders flagged and people who send them money. Yes, it acts on individual accounts. Expected 300 freezes a month. No, all users and affected people are in Pakistan and no output is used in the EU. It freezes accounts automatically with no human review first. Transaction flows and account opening data. No biometrics. Confirmed mule cases from the last two years. Not done. Onshore. Graph-based anomaly model. It does not create content. Nobody interacts with it. Reads payments data; writes freeze flags to core banking. Precision 60% on historical cases. Shows suspicious transaction chains. Not tested yet. Weekly review of freezes. Unfreeze in bulk if needed. All freezes logged.
Thank you, I have what I need. Generating the draft assessment now.
